title: UserPreferences
description: Per-user UI preferences. Each entry is a typed discriminated union — see preferences/*.json for concrete schemas.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the User this preferences bag belongs to.

preferences.description: List of typed per-user UI preferences (e.g. appMode). Each entry is a discriminated union keyed by `type`.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the preferences in Unix epoch time milliseconds.
